Scenario: Register new user log in verify profile and logout
Preconditions: Toolshop UI available. Registration page reachable. Email not already registered.
Test Data: First name: John. Last name: Doe. Email: john.doe.{unique}@example.com (timestamp suffix). Password: SuperSecure@123 (8+ chars upper lower number symbol).
Steps: 1) Open registration page. 2) Enter first name last name email password. 3) Submit registration. 4) Open login page. 5) Log in with same email and password. 6) Open profile from account menu (nav-profile). 7) Sign out from account menu.
Expected Result: Registration completes without error. Login succeeds with authenticated account menu visible. Profile shows John Doe and email matching registration. After Sign out user returns to guest state (Sign in visible; profile requires login).

Scenario: Multi-product cart quantity update COD checkout double Confirm and My Invoices
Preconditions: User logged in. Cart empty at start. Two in-stock products (API or catalog).
Test Data: Email: customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com. Password: welcome01. Products: two in-stock items (runtime). Qty: first product 1 to 2. Payment: Cash on Delivery. Billing: Jane Doe NL profile (Kanhaistraat Scherpenzeel Groningen Netherlands 1122AB).
Steps: 1) Log in. 2) Add two in-stock products to cart. 3) Verify two line items. 4) Update first product qty to 2; verify totals. 5) Proceed to checkout. 6) Complete billing. 7) Select Cash on Delivery. 8) Reach Confirm step. 9) Click Confirm once; verify not finalized. 10) Click Confirm second time. 11) Open My Invoices. 12) Record invoice_number and total. 13) Open Details for new invoice; verify line items and total on detail page.
Expected Result: Two products in cart. Qty change in totals. COD selected. After second Confirm invoice in My Invoices with INV-* number and total matching API. Invoice detail page shows both products and matching total.

Scenario: Single Confirm does not finalize invoice
Preconditions: User logged in. Isolated user recommended. One in-stock product.
Test Data: Dynamic user from TC-M-01 or dedicated account. Password per registration. Product: Combination Pliers. Payment: Cash on Delivery. Confirm clicks: 1 only.
Steps: 1) Log in. 2) Add one product. 3) Checkout COD to Confirm. 4) Click Confirm exactly once. 5) Open My Invoices without second Confirm.
Expected Result: No completed invoice for this order OR UI still requires second Confirm. Confirms R-01 double-Confirm requirement.
